title: Ziyarah of Imam Hassan Mujtaba (as)
description: Ziyahat of Imam Hassan (as) including the general Baqi Ziyarah and special Monday Ziyarah.

lines.english: Permission to Enter- Izn e Dukhool

lines.arabic: يَا مَوَالِيَّ يَا ابْنَاءَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: ya mawaliyya ya abna'a rasuli allahi
lines.english: O my masters, sons of the Messenger of Allah,
I—your servant and the son of your maid
who stand submissively before you,
who is worth nothing in comparison with your elevated esteem,
and who admits your right (that is incumbent upon us)—
have come to you, seeking your shelter,
heading for your sanctuary,
seeking nearness to Your statuses,
and beseeching Allah in your names.
May I enter, O my masters?
May I enter, O intimate servants of Allah?

lines.arabic: اادْخُلُ يَا مَلاَئِكَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُحْدِقينَ بِهٰذَا ٱلْحَرَمِ
lines.transliteration: a'adkhulu ya mala'ikata allahi almuhdiqina bihadha alharami
lines.english: May I enter, O Allah’s angels who surround this sanctuary
and reside in this shrine?
After you attain reverence, submission, and tenderheartedness, you may enter the shrine with your right foot, and say the following:
Allah is greatly the Greatest.
All praise be to Allah abundantly.

lines.transliteration: wa subhana allahi bukratan wa asilan
lines.english: Glory be to Allah in morns and eves.
All praise be to Allah, the Single, the Absolute,
the Glorious, the One and Only,
the All-obliging, the All-benefactor,
the Donor, the All-compassionate,
Who conferred (upon us) with His bequests,
Who has made easy for me to visit my masters out of His beneficence,
Who has not included me with those who are prevented from visiting them;
rather, He has bestowed upon me and donated me (this favor).
You may then move toward their tombs, face them, turn the back to the kiblah direction, and say the following:
Peace be upon you, O Leaders of true guidance.
Peace be upon you, O people of piety.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ايُّهَا ٱلْحُجَجُ عَلَىٰ اهْلِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Arguments against the inhabitants of this world.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ايُّهَا ٱلْقُوَّامُ فِي ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ بِٱلْقِسْطِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum ayyuha alquwwamu fi albariyyati bilqisti
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O maintainers of justice on people.
Peace be upon you, O choicest people.
Peace be upon you, O members of the Household of Allah’s Messenger.
Peace be upon you, O people of confidential talks (of the angels).

lines.transliteration: ashhadu annakum qad ballaghtum wa nasahtum
lines.english: I bear witness that you did convey, offer advice,
endure for the sake of Allah,

lines.transliteration: wa kudhdhibtum wa usi'a ilaykum faghafartum
lines.english: and forgive when you were belied and maltreated.

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annakumu al-a'immatu alrrashiduna almuhtaduna
lines.english: I also bear witness that you are the orthodox, well-guided Leaders,
that the obedience to you is obligatory,
that your words are true,
that you had called (to Allah) but you were not answered,
that you had enjoined (the right) but you were not obeyed,

lines.transliteration: wa annakum da`a'imu alddini wa arkanu al-ardi
lines.english: and that you are the supports of the religion and the poses of the earth.
You were always under the sight of Allah
Who moved you from the loins of purified men
to the wombs of purified women.
The benighted ignorance could not stain you

lines.transliteration: wa lam tashrak fikum fitanu al-ahwa'i
lines.english: and the whimsical sedition could not attract you.
Pleased be you as your origin has been pleased.
The King of the religion has conferred upon us with the grace of our acknowledgment of you;
He therefore caused you to be in houses
which He (i.e. Allah) has permitted to be exalted
and that His Name may be mentioned therein,
and He has decided our invocations of blessings upon you
to be mercy on us and to be granting remission of our sins.
Allah has chosen you for us

lines.arabic: وَطَيَّبَ خَلْقَنَا بِمَا مَنَّ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ وِلاَيَتِكُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa tayyaba khalqana bima manna `alayna min wilayatikum
lines.english: and has purified our creation through the grace of our loyalty to your (Divinely commissioned) Leadership with which He has conferred upon us.
We have thus become nominated with Him due to our acknowledgement of you
and our giving credence to you.

lines.transliteration: wa hadha maqamu man asrafa wa akhta'a
lines.english: So, this is the situation of him who has committed mistakes and sins,
shown submission (to you), and confessed of what he had committed.
Hence, being in this situation, I hope for redemption

lines.arabic: وَانْ يَسْتَنْقِذَهُ بِكُمْ مُسْتَنْقِذُ ٱلْهَلْكَىٰ مِنَ ٱلرَّدَىٰ
lines.english: and I hope that the Savior of the perishing ones from perdition may save me in your names.
So, (please) be my interceders,
for I have come to you
when the people of this world abandoned you,
took the Signs of Allah for a jest,
and turned away from them haughtily.
You may then raise your head toward the sky and say the following:

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ لاََ يَسْهُو
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa qa'imun la yashu
lines.english: O He Who is Self-Subsisting and never forgets,
Who is Ever-living and never becomes heedless,
and Who encompasses all things!
To You is all gratitude for that You have guided me (to this)
and You have introduced to me that on which I rest,
when Your servants diverted from it,
ignored the recognition of it,
belittled its right,
and inclined to elsewhere.
Hence, You have conferred upon me with this favor

lines.arabic: مَعَ اقْوَامٍ خَصَصْتَهُمْ بِمَا خَصَصْتَنِي بِهِ
lines.transliteration: ma`a aqwamin khasastahum bima khasastani bihi
lines.english: as well as upon other people whom You have granted exclusively the same.
So, all praise be to You, for I have been
mentioned and written with You due to the situation in which I am now.
Hence, (please) do not deprive me of what I long for,

lines.transliteration: wa la tukhayyibni fi ma da`awtu
lines.english: and do not disappoint me as regards my supplication;
(please do so) in the name of the sanctity of Muhammad and his immaculate Household.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: May Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
You may now pray Almighty Allah for anything you want.
In Tahdhib al-Ahkam, Shaykh al-Tusi says: You may then offer the Ziyarah Prayer (salat al-ziyarah) in eight units; each two units are for one of the (four) Imams.
Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus say that if you want to bid farewell to the four Imams, you may say the following:

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ ائِمَّةَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alaykum a'immata alhuda wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you, O leaders to the true guidance.
I entrust you with Allah([1]) and send salutations to you.
We believe in Allah and in the Messenger

lines.transliteration: wa bima ji'tum bihi wa dalaltum `alayhi
lines.english: and in that which you have conveyed and that to which you have guided.
O Allah, then write us down among those who bear witness.

First Section of Monday Ziarat

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ رَبِّ  لْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya ibna rasuli rabbi al`alamina
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of the Commander of the Believers!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّهْرَاءِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O son of Fatimah, the luminous lady!
Peace be on you, O beloved of Allah!
Peace be on you, O choice of Allah!
Peace be on you, O trustee of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Argument of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Light of Allah!
Peace be on you, O Path of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بَيَانَ حُكْمِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O elucidation of the rule of Allah!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَاصِرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be on you, O supporter of the religion of Allah!
Peace be on you, O pure master!
Peace be on you, O self-righteous and truthful!
Peace be on you, O practiser (of God’s commands) and trustee!
Peace be on you, O well-experienced in the interpretation (of the Qur'an)!
Peace be on you, O guide and well-guided!
Peace be on you, O immaculate and pure!
Peace be on you, O pious and infallible!
Peace be on you, O veritable truth!
Peace be on you, O martyr and veracious!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba muhammadin alhasana ibna `aliyyin
lines.english: Peace be on you, O Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan, the son of `Ali!
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you!
<div class="tab-pane fade"
Invocation of Blessings upon Imam Hassan(as)& Imam Hussain(as)
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn,
Your two servants and friends,
the two sons of Your Messengers, the two grandsons of Mercy,
and the two chiefs of the youth of Paradise,

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
lines.transliteration: afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min awladi alnnabiyyina walmursalina
lines.english: with the most excellent blessings that You have ever sent upon any of the sons of the Prophets and the Messengers.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱبْنِ سَيِّدِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala alhasani ibni sayyidi alnnabiyyina
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Hasan the son of the chief of the Prophets
and the successor of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: I bear witness that you are verily the son of the Commander of the Faithful,
the trustee of Allah, and the son of His trustee.
You lived upright and persecuted
and passed away as martyr.
And I bear witness that you are verily the pure,
guiding, and well-guided leader.
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon him
and convey to his soul and body

lines.arabic: فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَفْضَلَ ٱلتَّحِيَّةِ وَٱلسَّلاَمِ
lines.transliteration: fi hadhihi alssa`ati afdala alttahiyyati walssalami
lines.english: at this hour the best greeting and salutation from me.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
the oppressed, the martyr,
the slain by the unbelievers, and the thrown down by the sinful people.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah's Messenger.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

lines.arabic: أَشْهَدُ مُوقِناً أَنَّكَ أَمِينُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنُ أَمِينِهِ
lines.transliteration: ashhadu muqinan annaka aminu allahi wabnu aminihi
lines.english: I bear witness with full conviction that you are verily the trustee of Allah and the son of His trustee.
You were killed wrongly and you passed away as martyr.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَعَالَىٰ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِثَأْرِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna allaha ta`ala alttalibu bitha'rika
lines.english: I also bear witness that Allah the All-exalted is the One Who shall avenge You

lines.arabic: وَمُنْجِزٌ مَا وَعَدَكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّصْرِ وَٱلتَّأْيِيدِ
lines.transliteration: wa munjizun ma wa`adaka min alnnasri waltta'yidi
lines.english: and shall fulfill His promise to You of support and victory
through exterminating your enemies and demonstrating your call (to the true guidance).

lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wafayta bi`ahdi allahi
lines.english: I also bear witness that you fulfilled your covenant with Allah,
strove hard for His sake,

lines.arabic: وَعَبَدْتَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصاً حَتَّىٰ أَتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
lines.transliteration: wa `abadta allaha mukhlisan hatta ataka alyaqinu
lines.english: and served Allah sincerely until death came upon you.
May Allah curse the people who killed you.
May Allah curse the people who disappointed you.
May Allah curse the people who incited people against you.

lines.arabic: وَأَبْرَأُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ مَمَّنْ كَذَّبَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa abra'u ila allahi ta`ala mamman kadhdhabaka
lines.english: I release myself before Allah the All-exalted from those who belied you,

lines.transliteration: wa istakhaffa bihaqqika wa istahalla damaka
lines.english: belittled your right, and allowed themselves to shed your blood.

lines.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya aba `abdi allahi
lines.english: May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
Allah's curse be on those who killed you.
Allah's curse be on those who let you down.

lines.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ سَمِعَ وَاعِيَتَكَ فَلَمْ يُجِبْكَ وَلَمْ يَنْصُرْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man sami`a wa`iyataka falam yujibka wa lam yansurka
lines.english: Allah's curse be on those who heard your call (for help), but they refrained from responding to you or supporting you.

lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man saba nisa'aka
lines.english: Allah's curse be on those who captured your women.

lines.arabic: أَنَا إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ بَرِيءٌ وَمِمَّنْ وَالاَهُمْ
lines.transliteration: ana ila allahi minhum bari'un wa mimman walahum
lines.english: I disavow them all before Allah and disavow those who adhered to them,
those who kept up with them, and those who helped them against you.

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ وَٱلأَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِكَ كَلِمَةُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu annaka wal-a'immata min wuldika kalimatu alttaqwai
lines.english: I also bear witness that you and the Imams from your descendants are the word of piety,
the door to true guidance, the firmest handle,
and the argument against the inhabitants of this world.
I also bear witness that I have full faith in you,
I have conviction in your standing,
and I always follow you in myself,
in the laws of my religion, in my sealing deeds,

lines.transliteration: wa munqalabi wa mathwaya fi dunyaya wa akhirati
lines.english: in my tour, and in my settlement in this worldly life and the Hereafter.
